title: ARP Resolution Failure — Host Silent on dc1-leaf2b
symptom: Host in VRF VRF11 unreachable. ARP shows incomplete on dc1-leaf2b. Access port Ethernet8 connected. No fabric faults.
root_cause: Ethernet8 on dc1-leaf2b (host-facing access port) is shutdown. Host appears connected (NIC up) but no ingress traffic. ARP is incomplete because the OS is not responding.
